text.en: In the Shizunai dialect, the sequence *-r r-* frequently assimilates to [-nr-] ⟦claim:phon/coda-r-assimilation-sonorant-sandhi--the-sequence-r-r-frequently-assimilates-to-nr⟧. In addition, the sequence *e-an ya* becomes *e-an a* ⟦claim:phon/coda-r-assimilation-sonorant-sandhi--the-sequence-e-an-ya-becomes-e-an⟧.
text.ja: 静内方言において、*-r r-*の連続は頻繁に[-nr-]へと同化または異化する⟦claim:phon/coda-r-assimilation-sonorant-sandhi--the-sequence-r-r-frequently-assimilates-to-nr⟧。また、*e-an ya*という連続は*e-an a*となる⟦claim:phon/coda-r-assimilation-sonorant-sandhi--the-sequence-e-an-ya-becomes-e-an⟧。
